answer: An agent insurer covering a walnut orchard and a cedar plantation should reserve collateral for the full maximum payout of every policy until expiry. The ledger rejects any policy that reuses coins already reserved elsewhere, regardless of issuer key. A thousand fake insurers backed by the same deposit therefore cannot sell more total coverage. To issue a million credits of promises, an attacker must immobilize a million credits and pay financing costs; valid claims can seize that collateral.
